actions.title: Check the device answers
actions.description: Answers at once; used by Test connection.

actions.title: Read device details
actions.description: The device's OS, app version, battery and network.

actions.title: Take a screenshot
actions.description: Captures the screen, or one window.

window.description: Window title to capture; the whole screen when empty

file.description: Id of a file the device uploaded

actions.title: Show a notification
actions.description: Shows a notification on the device.

actions.title: Ask the person on the device
actions.description: Shows a question with buttons and returns the one pressed.

actions.title: List a folder
actions.description: Lists files in a folder the person allowed.

actions.title: Read a file
actions.description: Reads a file in an allowed folder, as text or as an uploaded file.

file.description: Id of a file the device uploaded

actions.title: Write a file
actions.description: Writes text or a Jizza file into an allowed folder.

actions.title: Move or rename a file
actions.description: Moves a file inside the allowed folders.

actions.title: Open a page
actions.description: Opens a page in the Jizza browser profile.

actions.title: Click on a page
actions.description: Clicks an element, found by its label, role or CSS selector.

actions.title: Type on a page
actions.description: Types into a field. A saved login is named by secretRef; the password never leaves the device.

actions.title: Read text or a table from a page
actions.description: Reads an element's text, a list or a table.

actions.title: Download a file
actions.description: Downloads a file from a page and uploads it to Jizza.

file.description: Id of a file the device uploaded

actions.title: Open URL
actions.description: Opens an HTTP or HTTPS URL in a browser session.

actions.title: Click element
actions.description: Clicks a located page element.

highlight.description: Outline the element on the page before acting on it.

actions.title: Point at it
actions.description: Moves the pointer over a located page element.

highlight.description: Outline the element on the page before acting on it.

actions.title: Type text
actions.description: Sets the value of a text field, optionally from a saved login.

highlight.description: Outline the element on the page before acting on it.

actions.title: Read text
actions.description: Reads text, value, or an attribute from an element.

highlight.description: Outline the element on the page before acting on it.

actions.title: Set checkbox
actions.description: Checks, unchecks, or toggles a checkbox.

highlight.description: Outline the element on the page before acting on it.

actions.title: Make sure it is on, off or open
actions.description: Presses a button that stays on (Follow), a section that opens (an accordion, More options), a tab or a switch only when it is not already in the state asked for, so a run never turns off what was already on.

highlight.description: Outline the element on the page before acting on it.

want.description: The state to leave it in: on/off for a button or switch, open/closed for a section or tab.

actions.title: Always close this if it shows up
actions.description: Tells the run which button closes something that pops up at any time (a cookie banner, an offer, a chat bubble). From this step on, before each step the run presses it whenever it is showing, and closes it again when it covers what a step needs. clear: true forgets them all.

highlight.description: Outline the element on the page before acting on it.

label.description: What it is, for the run's log: Cookie banner, Offer pop-up.

clear.description: Forget everything this run closes by itself (no element needed).

actions.title: Get checkbox state
actions.description: Reads whether a checkbox is checked.

highlight.description: Outline the element on the page before acting on it.

actions.title: Select item
actions.description: Selects one or more items in a list or select control.

highlight.description: Outline the element on the page before acting on it.

actions.title: Read a table
actions.description: Reads rows and columns from a table, including paginated tables.

highlight.description: Outline the element on the page before acting on it.

actions.title: Select radio button
actions.description: Selects a radio button directly or within a group.

highlight.description: Outline the element on the page before acting on it.

actions.title: Get radio state
actions.description: Reads a radio button or radio group's current state.

highlight.description: Outline the element on the page before acting on it.

actions.title: Scroll page
actions.description: Scrolls the page, an element, or until another element appears.

highlight.description: Outline the element on the page before acting on it.

actions.title: Send hotkeys
actions.description: Sends one or more keyboard keys, optionally to an element.

highlight.description: Outline the element on the page before acting on it.

actions.title: Type text key by key
actions.description: Types into a field with optional per-key delay.

highlight.description: Outline the element on the page before acting on it.

actions.title: Check it is on the page
actions.description: Checks whether a located element exists and is visible.

highlight.description: Outline the element on the page before acting on it.

actions.title: Switch browser context
actions.description: Switches to a tab, window, or frame.

actions.title: Refresh page
actions.description: Refreshes the current page.

actions.title: Get element selectors
actions.description: Builds robust selectors for an element.

highlight.description: Outline the element on the page before acting on it.

actions.title: Get web page details
actions.description: Returns requested details and files for the current page.

actions.title: Go forward
actions.description: Moves forward in browser history.

actions.title: Go back
actions.description: Moves back in browser history.

actions.title: Close browser
actions.description: Closes the current tab, session, or browser.

actions.title: Wait
actions.description: Waits for time, page state, or an element.

text.description: For text and textGone: the text to wait for.

urlContains.description: For url: part of the page address to wait for.

actions.title: Wait until the page answers
actions.description: Waits until the page shows one of several outcomes (results, a 'nothing found' message, an error) and says which one.

reloadFirst.description: Load the page again before looking (set by Jizza on each look after the first when the step polls).

outcomes.description: What can happen next, each with a name. The first one the page shows is the outcome.

gone.description: The element or text has gone instead.

actions.title: Upload a file
actions.description: Puts one of your files into the page's file box or drop zone (a photo, a signature, a document), resized first when the site has a limit.

file.description: The file: its id (a chat attachment, a run input, a downloaded file). Jizza hands it to the browser as {id, name, contentType, size}.

transform.description: For a picture the site limits: at most maxKb, width and height in pixels, as jpeg, png or webp. Only ever made smaller.

actions.title: Wait until
actions.description: Holds the run until an exact moment, such as when bookings open, by the site's own clock when it can read it.

at.description: The moment: a date and time with its offset (2026-12-01T10:00:00+05:30), or a local one with timeZone.

timeZone.description: The time zone of a local time, such as Asia/Kolkata. Jizza turns it into an exact moment before the browser gets the step.

clock.description: Whose clock: the site the browser is on, or the computer's.

leadMs.description: Go on this many ms early, for the time a click takes to reach the site.

actions.title: Tap on a picture
actions.description: Shows you a picture of a page area, such as a seat map, and clicks the places you tap on it.

points.description: Where to tap, as fractions of the area's width and height from its top-left corner. Left empty, Jizza shows you the picture to tap on.

actions.title: Take browser screenshot
actions.description: Captures the page or a located element.

highlight.description: Outline the element on the page before acting on it.

actions.title: Pick element
actions.description: Lets the person choose an element while designing a workflow.

actions.title: Record browser actions
actions.description: Records browser actions while designing a workflow.

actions.title: Answer browser pop-ups
actions.description: Answers the page's alert, confirm and prompt dialogs until it navigates, so a step that opens one does not wait for a person.

answer.description: accept = OK, dismiss = Cancel, off = let the page show its own dialogs again.

promptText.description: What to type into a prompt dialog when accepting.

times.description: Answer every dialog until the page changes, or only the next one.

actions.title: Drag and drop
actions.description: Drags a located element onto another element in the same frame.

highlight.description: Outline the element on the page before acting on it.

actions.title: Run web steps together
actions.description: Runs several web steps in one command, in order, stopping at the first that fails. Used for fast replay; each step is judged by the guardrails on its own before it is sent.

actions.title: Type a date
actions.description: Fills a date, time, or date and time field. Takes dates such as 2026-11-09, 09 Nov 2026, or 2026-11-09 18:30.

highlight.description: Outline the element on the page before acting on it.

value.description: The date (and time). Map it from earlier steps to fill it at run time.

format.description: Only for a plain text field: how the site writes dates, such as DD/MM/YYYY or DD MMM YYYY, HH:mm. Date pickers built into the browser need none.

actions.title: Tick several boxes
actions.description: Ticks the checkboxes of a group whose labels are listed, such as several interests or seats. Locate the group or any checkbox in it.

highlight.description: Outline the element on the page before acting on it.

items.description: Labels (or values) of the boxes to tick. Map a list, or comma-separated text, from earlier steps.

only.description: Untick the boxes in the group that are not listed.

actions.title: Read a list
actions.description: Reads the cards or rows of a list, such as the movies on a booking page, from one item of it.

highlight.description: Outline the element on the page before acting on it.

itemCss.description: A CSS pattern for every item of the list, saved when the list was marked while recording (Choose from a list of cards). It is tried before finding the list by its shape.

titleCss.description: Where each item's name is inside it, as CSS, saved when the person pointed at one item's name while recording. Items are named and chosen by that text.

within.description: Choose inside one card of another list first, such as the showtimes of one theatre: element is one card of that list, item says which card.

itemCss.description: A CSS pattern for every card of the outer list.

titleCss.description: Where each card's name is inside it, such as a theatre's name.

loadMore.description: For lists that load more as you scroll: scroll to the end, or press a Load more button, until the list stops growing.

groups.description: With within: also list the items inside every card of the outer list (the showtimes of each theatre), in groups.

captureItems.description: Also take a picture of each item's own box (the first 20), uploaded as files and named in the item's shot. An item whose picture cannot be taken just has none.

shot.description: The uploaded picture of this item's own box, when pictures were asked for.

groups.description: With groups: each card of the outer list, with the items inside it.

actions.title: Choose from a list
actions.description: Clicks the card or row of a list whose text matches, such as a movie or a date, finding the list as it is when the step runs.

highlight.description: Outline the element on the page before acting on it.

item.description: Which item to click: its text, such as a movie name (several words separated by commas must all be in the card, such as Ramayana, Hindi, 3D), a date, or its position with by index. Map it to choose at run time.

itemCss.description: A CSS pattern for every item of the list, saved when the list was marked while recording (Choose from a list of cards). It is tried before finding the list by its shape.

titleCss.description: Where each item's name is inside it, as CSS, saved when the person pointed at one item's name while recording. Items are named and chosen by that text.

within.description: Choose inside one card of another list first, such as the showtimes of one theatre: element is one card of that list, item says which card.

itemCss.description: A CSS pattern for every card of the outer list.

titleCss.description: Where each card's name is inside it, such as a theatre's name.

loadMore.description: For lists that load more as you scroll: scroll to the end, or press a Load more button, until the list stops growing.

prefer.description: When several items match, or no item is named: ask, take the first, or take the cheapest or dearest by the price in its text.

actions.title: Press one of these buttons
actions.description: Clicks one of a group of buttons the person grouped while recording (such as हिंदी or English), chosen by name. With no name, clicks whichever of them the page shows.

highlight.description: Outline the element on the page before acting on it.

options.description: The grouped buttons, each with its name and element.

item.description: Which button to click, by its name. Empty: whichever of them is on the page. Map it to choose at run time.

actions.title: Pick from a dropdown
actions.description: Chooses one option of a dropdown by its name: a plain select, or a dropdown the site built (opened, then the option clicked). Static keeps the options read while recording to offer on each run; dynamic reads them from the page when the run gets here.

highlight.description: Outline the element on the page before acting on it.

item.description: The option to choose, by its name as the dropdown shows it.

options.description: The options read while recording (Static), offered when a run asks which to choose.

mode.description: Static: offer the options saved while recording. Dynamic: read the options from the page when the run gets here.

actions.title: Read a dropdown's choices
actions.description: Reads the options of a dropdown: a plain select's, or a site-built one's by opening it, reading them and closing it again.

highlight.description: Outline the element on the page before acting on it.

actions.title: Fill a row per person or item
actions.description: A section the page repeats, one per person (passengers): presses the add button (Add passenger) until there is a row for each entry, then fills each row's fields with that entry's values.

highlight.description: Outline each field on the page before filling it.

add.description: The button that adds a row.

rows.description: One entry per row: each column's value by its key.

actions.title: Fill several fields
actions.description: Fills several fields of a form in one step: text, text areas, dropdowns, checkboxes, checkbox groups, radio buttons and dates, each from a value or from earlier steps.

highlight.description: Outline each field on the page before filling it.

value.description: Text, a choice, true or false for a checkbox, or a list for a checkbox group.

submit.description: The button that sends the form. When set, the step presses it and reads the errors the site shows.

actions.title: Fill a whole form
actions.description: Fills a whole area of a page in one step, such as a Create task form: fixed values first, then the values for this run group by group, waiting for a dropdown that loads after another, then clicks one of the area's buttons. Each button leads to its own path.

highlight.description: Outline each field on the page before filling it.

root.description: The box that holds the page area. Checked before anything is filled.

value.description: Text, a choice, true or false for a checkbox, or a list for a checkbox group.

dependsOn.description: The id of the field whose choice loads this one's options.

within.description: A list field inside one card of another list, as Choose from a list keeps it.

button.description: The button to click at the end, by its id or name. Map it to choose at run time; empty asks.

startAt.description: Carry on from this field; the ones before it are already filled.

actions.title: Read the suggestions
actions.description: Types into a field that suggests as you type (a station, a city) and reads the suggestions the site shows for that text, without choosing one. The list is closed again afterwards.

actions.title: Read a form's fields
actions.description: Reads one area of a page, such as a Create task form: its fields in page order with their kind, value and choices, their groups, which dropdown loads after which, and its buttons. Never reads a password or card field's value.

root.description: The box that holds the area. The page's form, else its main part, when empty.

actions.title: Pick a date in a calendar
actions.description: Picks a date in a calendar the site draws itself, or in a strip of dates: opens it, moves to the month and clicks the day.

highlight.description: Outline the element on the page before acting on it.

opener.description: What to click first to open the calendar, if it is not open.

date.description: The date, such as 2026-11-09 or 9 Nov 2026. Map it to pick at run time.

actions.title: Type and pick a suggestion
actions.description: For dropdowns you search in, such as a city or a theatre: types into the field, waits for the suggestions and clicks the one that matches.

highlight.description: Outline the element on the page before acting on it.

option.description: Which suggestion to choose, if not the text typed.

optionElement.description: One suggestion, as recorded, to find the others by.

actions.title: Ask me
actions.description: Stops and asks you on a card in Jizza (and in the browser's side panel), with a picture of part of the page if you pick one, then types your answer into a box on the page or passes it to the next steps. For CAPTCHAs and one-time codes: you solve them, Jizza never does.

expectOrigin.description: The site the step was recorded on: it refuses to act while the tab shows another one.

picture.description: Part of the page shown on the card (a CAPTCHA, a total).

answerElement.description: The box on the page your answer is typed into.

secret.description: Never show, keep or report the answer (a CAPTCHA, a code).

wantsAnswer.description: Off: the card only asks you to press Done after doing it in the browser.

actions.title: Hand over to me
actions.description: Brings the tab to the front and waits while you do something only you should, like paying. The run carries on when the page shows success or failure, or when you press Done. Jizza types and clicks nothing meanwhile.

expectOrigin.description: The site the step was recorded on: it refuses to act while the tab shows another one.

message.default: Finish this in the browser, then press Done.

successUrl.description: Done well when the address contains this (* matches anything).

successText.description: ...or when the page shows this text.

actions.title: Run a recorded browser task
actions.description: Deprecated: Replays steps recorded once in the Jizza Agent app.

actions.title: Open an app
actions.description: Starts or focuses a desktop app.

actions.title: Click in an app
actions.description: Clicks a control in an app window, found by its accessibility name.

actions.title: Type in an app
actions.description: Types into a control in an app window.

actions.title: Read an app window
actions.description: Reads the text of a window or one control.

actions.title: Press keys in an app
actions.description: Presses keys or shortcuts in an app window, such as Enter, Tab or Ctrl+S. Keys use SendKeys notation: {ENTER}, {TAB}, ^s for Ctrl+S, %f for Alt+F.

actions.title: Fill a form in an app
actions.description: Fills several controls of an app window in one step: text boxes, dropdowns, checkboxes, radio buttons and dates, each from a value or from earlier steps.

element.description: The control's accessibility name, #automationId or Type:Name.

actions.title: List items in an app
actions.description: Reads the rows of a list, table, tree or dropdown in an app window.

element.description: The list control's accessibility name, #automationId or Type:Name.

actions.title: Choose from a list in an app
actions.description: Selects the row of a list, table, tree or dropdown in an app whose text matches, as the list is when the step runs.

element.description: The list control's accessibility name, #automationId or Type:Name.

prefer.description: When several items match, or no item is named: ask, take the first, or take the cheapest or dearest by the price in its text.

actions.title: Record app actions
actions.description: Records clicks, typing and shortcuts in Windows apps while a person shows a task, for review and saving as a workflow.

actions.title: Read a spreadsheet
actions.description: Reads rows from an Excel or CSV file in an allowed folder.

actions.title: Write to a spreadsheet
actions.description: Writes rows into an Excel or CSV file in an allowed folder.

actions.title: Get the phone's location
actions.description: Asks the phone where it is.

actions.title: Take a photo
actions.description: Asks the person to take a photo on the phone.

file.description: Id of a file the device uploaded

actions.title: Scan a document
actions.description: Asks the person to scan a document; returns the file and its text.

file.description: Id of a file the device uploaded

actions.title: Run an iOS Shortcut
actions.description: Runs one of the person's Shortcuts by name.

actions.title: Send an Android intent
actions.description: Starts an app action on Android.

actions.title: Run a shell command
actions.description: Runs a command. Never sent unless shell is turned on for that device.

actions.title: List a local MCP server's tools
actions.description: Starts the MCP server set up under this name in the app, if it is not running, and lists its tools. Used by the server's card in Connectors, never offered to agents as a device tool.

server.description: The MCP server's name as it is set up in the app on this computer

actions.title: Call a local MCP server's tool
actions.description: Calls one tool of the MCP server set up under this name in the app. The guardrails judge each tool as its owner typed it on the server's card; the app may still ask before it runs.

server.description: The MCP server's name as it is set up in the app on this computer
